files.README.md:
# Bitbucket Data Center

Pilot with read operations and pull request comments requiring confirmation. Use the HTTPS instance URL and project/repository. Configure the account token and permitted resources in Talia.

packages.description_it: Connettore pilota per Bitbucket Data Center, limitato alle risorse selezionate. Consente commenti alle pull request previa conferma.
